canonical_algorithm.paper: M. Torquati, Single-Producer/Single-Consumer Queues on Shared Cache Multi-Core Systems

official_artifact.current_project_license_statement: dual LGPL-3.0/MIT for current releases; not mapped to the exact 2010 artifact

semantic_adaptations: Protocol-declared fixed arena replaces the paper source allocation fallback with immediate full
Exactly one sentinel plus C event nodes are cache-line-strided using an explicit verified runtime byte count
Caller supplies the validated treatment-blind C+1 node permutation; Stage 5 does not select its generator
Detached old sentinels return through a separate bounded circular SPSC atomic-pointer recycler
Recycler invariant failure is a correctness stop and never an EMPTY or FULL outcome
Stage 6 makes the linked node arena use an explicit page/base alignment in addition to its explicit cache-line stride
Stage 6 adds a statically bound successor-header policy seam immediately after the consumer acquire and before the successor event-field demand
The off package compiles the successor seam away; platform software-prefetch instruction encoding remains unresolved
memory_order_mapping: producer acquire-removes a recycler node and release-clears the recycler slot
producer initializes node fields then release-publishes predecessor.next
consumer acquire-loads head.next before reading the successor event
consumer advances private head then release-returns the detached old sentinel
producer acquire-loads the returned sentinel before reinitialization
head and tail are non-atomic single-writer state

atomic_and_alignment.atomic_type: std::atomic<Node*> for links and recycler slots
atomic_and_alignment.alignment_expectation: natural atomic alignment; every node and each ownership state begins on an explicit verified cache-line boundary

claim_boundary.linearizability: fixed-arena bounded FIFO try operations for exactly one producer and one consumer
claim_boundary.wait_free: each individual FIFO/recycler try operation under valid SPSC and lock-free pointer-atomic preconditions
claim_boundary.lock_free: no reclamation or general linked-queue claim beyond the fixed Stage A SPSC object
claim_boundary.excluded: fallback allocation, hazard pointers, epochs, MPSC, MPMC, Stage B, platform prefetch instruction encoding, measurement

coverage: exact C+1 cycle and repeated recycler reuse
